summary: The debrief fold's own turn record now points at its working set where the candidate data already sits, not only in the distant objective.
details: The `<steps>` block's description now says: when a result below names several of a kind and the delivered row sent only some, the rest sitting there unsent is the working set.
limitations: Annotation only, held at objective v10; whether this alone moves the write rate is a separate, measured question (issue #445).
